meta.title: TrayNook · Menu bar organizer for Mac
meta.description: A free app for organizing your Mac’s menu bar. Keep icons in view, move them into a dropdown, or hide them.
meta.socialDescription: Keep the icons you reach for in the menu bar. Tuck the rest into TrayNook’s dropdown or hide them. Free and open source for macOS.
meta.imageAlt: TrayNook’s red panda icon and a screenshot of its open dropdown beside the headline “A little room for your menu bar.”

hero.description: A free app for organizing your Mac’s menu bar. Keep the icons you use every day in view, move others into a dropdown, or hide them.

items.question: How do I install TrayNook?
paragraphs: You can build from source with Xcode and Swift 6. Check GitHub Releases or the Homebrew tap for packaged builds.
Builds use ad hoc signing by default. If macOS blocks the first launch, follow Apple’s instructions.

items.question: Which permissions does TrayNook need?
paragraphs: Accessibility lets TrayNook move icons and open their menus. You may need to grant it again after an update.
Screen Recording is optional. Grant it to see the same symbols as in the menu bar. Otherwise, the dropdown shows app icons.

items.question: Will it work on my Mac?
paragraphs: TrayNook builds for Intel and Apple silicon. It targets versions of macOS that get security updates from Apple. The minimum is macOS 13.0. Check the release notes for tested versions.

items.question: Why do some icons stay visible?
paragraphs: Protected system icons stay put, as do icons TrayNook can’t reliably identify. Which icons can move depends on the app and your display setup.
If something looks wrong, report an issue. You choose whether to share diagnostics.

items.question: What leaves my Mac?
paragraphs: TrayNook keeps your layout and settings on your Mac. It sends no analytics, list of apps, or screenshots.

By default, TrayNook checks GitHub for updates. GitHub sees your IP address and request details. You can turn checks off in Settings. Automatic downloads are off by default, and you approve each installation.
